native-exact.duplicates: Distinct occurrence IDs/paths/ordinals survive; duplicate JSON members reject in profile QA.
native-exact.groups: Namespace/nativeId/path define identity; metadata-family labels never collapse occurrences.
native-exact.lists: Occurrence arrays are tables; list-valued/structured metadata is outside current R5 subset.
native-exact.language: No lang-alt values; display locale en and timezone null, with exact layers retained.
native-exact.binary: Resource references and unchanged-source ranges only; no inline/base64 bytes.
native-exact.encoding: UTF-8 JSON, valid Unicode scalars, canonical unsigned decimal strings; no nonfinite/trailing JSON.
native-exact.omission: Partial coverage and filtered omissions never prove absence; optional members follow linked schemas.
native-exact.empty: Empty occurrence table differs from empty string and unavailable display; exact schema states remain.
native-exact.null: Only exact schema nullable fields accept null (including unavailable hashes); null is not deletion.
native-exact.missing: Missing required members reject; missing observed occurrences have no inferred stored value.
native-exact.matching: Report labels and local snapshot IDs are not target authority; no importer.
native-exact.loss: Decoded exact values retain origin ranges, but no standalone byte round trip; display/path loss explicit.

native-display.duplicates: Each selected occurrence prints separately with source ordinal; no suppress-by-name rule.
native-display.groups: Printed namespace/name and ordinal are a human projection, not complete path identity.
native-display.lists: No list metadata renderer or machine list grammar.
native-display.language: Existing reader display only; no language-choice or locale-switch contract.
native-display.binary: Printed stored length/offset description; no binary payload or reversible grammar.
native-display.encoding: Human text with quoted path heading and checked ASCII metadata strings; terminal evidence is finite.
native-display.omission: Unprinted selected/unsupported occurrences do not prove absence under partial coverage.
native-display.empty: Empty printed value has no machine empty/null/delete interpretation.
native-display.null: No machine null sentinel or intent interpretation.
native-display.missing: Missing line is not an absence or deletion assertion.
native-display.matching: Printed paths/names never match import targets.
native-display.loss: Display is a human projection; full exact states/path/coverage must use native JSON.

legacy-open.duplicates: Unimplemented; before implementation specify preserve/suppress/collision behavior per profile; ambiguous flattening refuses in the proposed adapter.
legacy-open.groups: Unimplemented; explicit group projection/lookup grammar required; names alone cannot choose occurrences.
legacy-open.lists: Unimplemented; list shape/order/separator/escaping require exact schema and comparison vectors.
legacy-open.language: Unimplemented; language selection/default/fallback and identity need an explicit schema.
legacy-open.binary: Unimplemented; inline/reference/base64/omission must be named; no implicit byte-to-string coercion.
legacy-open.encoding: Unimplemented; charset, escaping, newlines, numeric quoting and invalid input require profile-specific grammar.
legacy-open.omission: Unimplemented; omission must be distinguished from unsupported, absent and unrequested values.
legacy-open.empty: Unimplemented; empty field/string/list rules must be explicit; no silent delete.
legacy-open.null: Unimplemented; null/sentinel meaning cannot be inferred from syntax or mapped to delete.
legacy-open.missing: Unimplemented; missing row/column/member and missing occurrence need distinct diagnostics.
legacy-open.matching: Unimplemented; templates/filename lookup and SourceFile matching require explicit collision/alias rules; no fallback.
legacy-open.loss: Unimplemented; adapters must enumerate/report projected losses; unexplained lossy conversion refuses.

inert-scalar.duplicates: Duplicate JSON members or repeated sourceKey/snapshotId/occurrenceId edits refuse, including equal values.
inert-scalar.groups: Exact sourceKey/snapshotId/occurrenceId plus namespace/nativeId match an immutable caller table retaining full path/ordinal; labels never select.
inert-scalar.lists: List/structure values and append operations refuse; only existing scalar set.
inert-scalar.language: Language alternative/display-only values refuse; string literals receive no language interpretation.
inert-scalar.encoding: Strict UTF-8 without BOM; Unicode scalars; JSON escaping or strict comma/double-quote/CRLF CSV; canonical decimal strings.
inert-scalar.omission: No edit omits a required field or represents implicit action; omitted occurrences remain untouched intent-wise.
inert-scalar.empty: String text empty is explicit set-to-empty; empty numeric/identity values refuse; empty batch refuses.
inert-scalar.null: JSON null and null value-state refuse; CSV has no null sentinel.
inert-scalar.missing: Missing JSON member, CSV cell/header, source binding or occurrence refuses entire batch.
inert-scalar.matching: Exact case-sensitive observation-table keys; no paths, basename, glob, SourceFile, trimming, Unicode normalization or positional fallback.
inert-scalar.loss: No silent loss or acknowledgement bypass; retain exact typed strings/rational pair/order, with no executable authority.
